Events.Title: 1. Login validation
Events.Detail: An incorrect password is rejected; password characters are masked.

Events.Title: 2. Required-field validation
Events.Detail: A complaint requires a title, category and description.

Events.Title: 3. Submit a Billing complaint
Events.Detail: The real service saves the ticket and returns its unique reference.

Events.Title: 4. Track the saved reference
Events.Detail: The Customer sees Pending status and initial review notes.

Events.Title: 5. Unknown and blank reference checks
Events.Detail: A miss clears prior details; blank input gets an explicit alert.

Events.Title: 6. Support Agent login
Events.Detail: A fresh service reloads persisted records for the agent workflow.

Events.Title: 7. Filter and refresh the ticket grid
Events.Detail: A Technical filter has no match; Refresh restores all complaints.

Events.Title: 8. Resolve the selected ticket
Events.Detail: One selected row enables status/category editing and multiline notes.

Events.Title: 9. Reopen and reload persisted data
Events.Detail: A new service reads the saved update before the Customer signs in again.

Events.Title: 10. Persisted resolution confirmed
Events.Detail: The Customer now sees Resolved, Service, the update time and the agent's saved notes.

Events.Title: Demonstration complete
Events.Detail: Core workflow, validation, filtering and persisted resolution demonstrated. Human acceptance is recorded separately.
